plan.reason: CIRCLE LINE: Thursday 26, all day, and until 1200 Friday 27 November, no service due to strike action.

TUBE STRIKE: Some London Underground Tube drivers are planning to take strike action from 1200 Thursday 26 until 1159 Friday 27 November. A normal service is expected until 1000 Thursday when services will begin to reduce. From 1200, there will be disruption on all lines and no service is expected after 2100. No trains will run all day Thursday and until 1200 Friday on the Circle and Piccadilly lines, or on the Waterloo & City line between 1200 Thursday and 1200 Friday. Disruption will continue between 1200 and 1800 Friday, with a normal service expected after then
WATERLOO & CITY LINE: From 1200 Thursday 26 until 1200 Friday 27 November, no service due to strike action.

NORTHERN LINE: Saturday 28 November, between 0045 and 0530 approximately, and Sunday 29 November, between 0045 and 0710 approximately, no Friday and Saturday Night Tube service between Kennington and Stockwell. For travel between Central London and Stockwell, and stations to Morden, please use the Victoria line. For Oval, please use Night Bus N155 between Kennington and Stockwell.

WINDRUSH LINE: From 0100 Saturday 28 and all day Sunday 29 November, including Friday and Saturday Night Overground, no service between Highbury & Islington and Battersea Park / Clapham Junction / New Cross / New Cross Gate. Use MILDMAY LINE services between Highbury & Islington, Canonbury and Dalston Kingsland. Replacement bus services operate.
CIRCLE LINE: Saturday 28 and Sunday 29 November, no service between Hammersmith / High Street Kensington and Tower Hill (via Kings Cross St Pancras)
DISTRICT LINE: Saturday 28 and Sunday 29 November, no service between High Street Kensington and Edgware Road. There will also be no CIRCLE LINE service on this section.

ELIZABETH LINE: Saturday 28 and Sunday 29 November, no service between Maidenhead / Heathrow (all terminals) and Abbey Wood / Shenfield. Use PICCADILLY LINE services between Heathrow and Central London. LONDON PADDINGTON STATION will be closed on this day, with no HEATHROW EXPRESS services. GWR services will not run between Maidenhead / Greenford and Paddington, with limited long distance services to/from Euston. There will also be no GREATER ANGLIA services on these days between Shenfield / Southend Victoria / Southminster and Liverpool Street, use CENTRAL LINE connections between Ealing Broadway, West Acton (for Acton Main Line), Central London, Liverpool Street, Stratford and Newbury Park. Replacement bus services operate, not serving Iver, please use Langley instead.

HAMMERSMITH & CITY LINE: Saturday 28 and Sunday 29 November, no service on the entire line. There will also be no CIRCLE LINE service between Hammersmith / High Street Kensington and Tower Hill (via Kings Cross St Pancras). Use DISTRICT LINE services between Aldgate East and Barking.
LIBERTY LINE: Saturday 28 and Sunday 29 November, no service between Romford and Upminster. Use local London Buses services 165 248 and 370 instead.
METROPOLITAN LINE: Saturday 28 and Sunday 29 November, no service between Baker Street and Aldgate. There will also be no CIRCLE or HAMMERSMITH & CITY LINE services on this section.

WINDRUSH LINE: Sunday 29 November, until 0800, no service between Sydenham and West Croydon. Customers should use local buses or trams via any reasonable route. First Trains: New Cross Gate to West Croydon 0747; West Croydon to New Cross Gate 0818

WINDRUSH LINE: From 0100 Saturday 5 and all day Sunday 6 December, including Friday and Saturday Night Overground, no service between Highbury & Islington and Battersea Park / Clapham Junction / New Cross / New Cross Gate. Use MILDMAY LINE services between Highbury & Islington, Canonbury and Dalston Kingsland. Replacement bus services operate.

BAKERLOO LINE: Sunday 6 December, no service between Queens Park and Harrow & Wealdstone. There will also be no LIONESS LINE service between Willesden Junction and Harrow & Wealdstone. Special bus service 718 operates. LONDON NORTH WESTERN RAILWAY trains continue to stop at Harrow & Wealdstone. SOUTHERN trains stop at Wembley Central and Harrow & Wealdstone between 1300 and 2000 only

DISTRICT LINE: Sunday 6 December, no service between Turnham Green and Richmond. There will also be no MILDMAY LINE service between Willesden Junction and Richmond. Replacement bus service R operates between Willesden Junction and Richmond via Acton Central (The Vale), South Acton (Acton Lane), Turnham Green Station, Chiswick Park (Chiswick High Road), Gunnersbury and Kew Gardens (Royal Botanic Gardens).

ELIZABETH LINE: Sunday 6 December, until 0900, no service between West Drayton and Slough. Replacement bus service W1 operates between Hayes & Harlington and Slough via West Drayton and Langley (not serving Iver).

LIONESS LINE: Sunday 6 December, no service between Willesden Junction and Harrow & Wealdstone. There will also be no BAKERLOO LINE service between Queens Park and Harrow & Wealdstone. Special bus service 718 operates. LONDON NORTH WESTERN RAILWAY trains continue to stop at Harrow & Wealdstone. SOUTHERN trains stop at Wembley Central and Harrow & Wealdstone between 1300 and 2000 only

MILDMAY LINE: Sunday 6 December, no service between Willesden Junction and Richmond. There will also be no DISTRICT LINE service between Turnham Green and Richmond. Replacement bus service DL3 operates between Willesden Junction and Richmond via Acton Central (The Vale), South Acton (Acton Lane), Turnham Green Station, Chiswick Park (Chiswick High Road), Gunnersbury and Kew Gardens (Royal Botanic Gardens).

CENTRAL LINE: Sunday 13 December, between 0130 and 0530, no Saturday Night Tube service between Marble Arch and Ealing Broadway. Replacement bus service CL1 operates between Marble Arch and Ealing Broadway via Lancaster Gate, Queensway, Notting Hill Gate, Holland Park, Shepherds Bush, White City, East Acton, North Acton and West Acton.
CENTRAL LINE: Sunday 13 December, from 0530, no service between White City and Ealing Broadway / Northolt. Replacement buses operate.

MILDMAY LINE: Tuesday 15, Wednesday 16, Thursday 17 and Friday 18 December, until 0615 each morning, no southbound service from Willesden Junction to Shepherds Bush. The 0552 first train from Willesden Junction to Clapham Junction starts from Shepherd's Bush and the 0608 second train from Willesden Junction to Clapham Junction does not run. Use the next service at 0623 or local bus routes 220 or 228. The 0611 Stratford to Clapham Junction train starts at Shepherds Bush, and the 0651 Stratford to Richmond train starts at Acton Central.

TUBE STRIKE: Some London Underground Tube drivers are planning to take strike action from 12:00 Thursday 17 until 11:59 Friday 18 December. There is likely to be some disruption across all Underground lines, but trains are expected to run on most lines.

TUBE STRIKE: Some London Underground Tube drivers are planning to take strike action from 12:00 Saturday 19 until 11:59 Sunday 20 December. There is likely to be some disruption across all Underground lines, but trains are expected to run on most lines.
